title: Konflux UI Segment Events
description: Union of all Konflux UI analytics event types

CommonFields.description: Base fields required on every Segment event sent from Konflux UI

clusterId.description: Unique identifier of the cluster, used as salt for obfuscating PIA fields

user_login_event.description: Fired when a user successfully authenticates into Konflux

user_logout_event.description: Fired when a user session ends, either by explicit logout or session expiry

JourneyStep.description: A single step (page visit) within a user's navigation journey

path.description: Route pattern of the page, e.g. /ns/:workspaceName/applications. Must be the route pattern, not the resolved URL — never include workspace/tenant names or other identifiers from the actual path.

durationMs.description: Time in milliseconds the user spent on this step

toPath.description: Route pattern the user navigated to after leaving this step. Absent on the last (still-open) step. Must be the route pattern, not the resolved URL.

user_journey_event.description: Fired once per session, capturing the full navigation path and per-page dwell times

sessionStartedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the session started

totalDurationMs.description: Total duration of the session in milliseconds

steps.description: Ordered list of steps (page visits) taken during the session

journeyId.description: Stable identifier linking all parts of a split journey. Only present when auto-split fires (payload exceeded size threshold).

journeyPartIndex.description: Zero-based index of this part within a split journey. Only present when auto-split fires.

feedback_submitted_event.description: Fired when a user submits feedback through the Konflux UI

rating.description: User satisfaction rating, typically on a 1-5 scale

feedback.description: Free-text feedback provided by the user

email.description: Optional contact email provided by the user for follow-up
